physical_identity: The Frontrooms cruise ship Adventure (~150 m x 18 m), renamed SS Fun =), trashed by Partygoers; exterior decks follow normal reality, lower decks are infinite party-room labyrinths.
scale_topology: Ship exterior finite (top, upper, main decks); interior lower decks infinite from an elevator hub; the ship itself relocates between levels.
anomalies: travels by no-clip inside periodic green fog
spontaneous item generation and cloned rooms (Liminal Echo, Phenomenon 7)
party paraphernalia and posters no-clip wanderers
lighting_sound: Party decor and dark corners; screams echo down corridors; green fog on departure. Other sound not stated.

signature_mechanic: A ship that vanishes in green fog and whose lower decks are an infinite party-room maze reached by elevator; poster items no-clip you in or out.
verticality: Ship decks up to a sun deck; elevator descends to infinite lower decks.
conflicts_notes: Stone circle section reads as Level 246 context but says entrance/exits for wanderers; the personal entry places the author on Level 246. Escape testimony names Level 4. Adventure appearance list includes Level 246 as land.

key_quotes.quote: Periodically, a green fog will cover the ship like a magician's cape.
These three exterior decks primarily follow reality as we understand it.
Lower decks appear infinite, as screams echo down endless corridors
The elevators are the hub of these lower decks
There are no friendly bases, outposts or communities on this constantly moving level.
You can also board the ship after it materializes.
Touch a reversed, out-of-focus party poster, and you will no-clip to another level.
